title: Data source research candidate
description: One evaluated candidate produced by the research-sources skill. File name: research/candidates/<slug>.json

slug.description: Matches the filename stem and the memo slug.

gap.description: What existing gap in sources.yaml / scoring this would fill.

granularity.description: tract | zcta | county | cbsa/metro | state | national

history_available.description: How far back usable history goes.

license.description: License/ToS summary, including any login, key, or commercial-use restriction.

cost.description: Confirm free vs. trial vs. paid, and any rate limit.

correlation.description: Quantitative evaluation vs. FHFA HPI / Zillow ZORI growth, if app/research/evaluate_series.py was run.

recommendation.description: One paragraph: recommend / don't recommend, and why.
